model.title: Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL amending Regulation (EU) 2024/1787 on the reduction of methane emissions in the energy sector as regards the postponement of certain obligations

summary.text: This proposal would delay certain requirements that energy companies must follow to reduce methane gas leaks from their operations. The postponement would apply to specific obligations that were set out in recently established rules on cutting methane emissions from the energy sector.
